claims.experiment: Compare modeled acceleration histories of small and massive globules with the observed splinter population.
claims.result: Small globules began acceleration only tens of thousands of years ago; massive globules have longer acceleration histories.
claims.finding: Recent fragmentation and detachment explains small B1 globules, but does not explain B2.

evidence.quote: our analysis places most of the smallest globules relatively close to their current position only a few tens of thousands years ago, when they started to be propelled by the rocket effect.
This indicates a good agreement with a recent fragmentation and detachment from larger globules
There is an exception to this conclusion: block B2 globules are not associated with any large globule, so in this case, fragmentation and detachment is not a good explanation.

claims.hypothesis: Rocket-accelerated globules can form low-mass walkaway or runaway stars.
claims.experiment: Compare modeled evaporation lifetimes with collapse times and extrapolate globule velocities to potential protostars.
claims.result: Th01A has a modeled survival time over an order of magnitude longer than its free-fall time.
claims.finding: Formation of accelerated stars is possible in a rare, extreme case; fragmentation makes the outcome difficult.

evidence.quote: This survival time is more than 1 order of magnitude larger than its free-fall time
these protostars would inherit the high velocity of the globule and may become low-mass walkaways/runaways from Collinder 249.
the globule survival is threatened by other processes which speed up destruction, indicating that the runaway hypothesis is a difficult outcome.

why_this_data.value: Map cold continuum and molecular emission and cover globules previously imaged by HST.

evidence.quote: Here we present the analysis of Band 3 ALMA data that reveals the cold emission (continuum and molecular) associated with the neutral gas and its kinematic behavior.
a small mosaic of 19 Nyquist-sampled pointings was used to ensure the spatial coverage of those globules mapped in previous Hubble Space Telescope observations

why_this_method.value: Linear gradients suggest acceleration; isolated globules motivate testing rocket acceleration rather than a pillar-based instability scenario.

evidence.quote: In contrast, linear velocity gradients, as observed, can indicate that the globules are being accelerated
but isolated globules following a linear velocity gradient, we discuss a different working hypothesis.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Constant-velocity spherical expanding layer is unexpected given the linear velocity gradients.

evidence.quote: This would be unexpected if the globules were located on the surface of a spherical layer that expands at constant velocity.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: A turbulent origin is difficult to reconcile with the gradients.

evidence.quote: It would also be difficult to reconcile it with an origin of the globules from a large-scale turbulent medium bathed by ionizing radiation

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Rayleigh-Taylor instability considered; clear gradients along pillar-like structures are not generally seen.

evidence.quote: An alternative explanation for the velocity gradient is a large-scale Rayleigh-Taylor instability in a denser shell pushed by the expanding HII region
Since we do not see clear velocity gradients along pillar-like structures

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: B3 could be unrelated projected gas; excluded from further analysis.

evidence.quote: An alternative is that block B3 globules do not relate to the expanding shell and acceleration process from these O stars, and they just serendipitously lie in projection with the other globules.
from now on we consider the B3 globules unrelated to Thackeray’s globules and will not include them in further analysis.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Th14 velocity gradient may indicate rotation, rocket acceleration, or another instability.

evidence.quote: which may be indicative of rotation, although with the data at hand, we cannot rule out other possible origin, such as rocket acceleration or Rayleigh-Jeans instability, for instance.

limitations_admitted.value: Moderate 13CO optical depth in some spots can underestimate density and mass by factors 1.1–2.3.

evidence.quote: $^{13}$CO emission is moderately optically thick ($\tau_{\rm 13CO}\approx 1$) in a few spots of Th01A, Th01B, Th01C, Th02A, and Th14
which may imply density and mass underestimations of factors 1.1-2.3 in these few lines-of-sight.

limitations_admitted.value: Approximately 10% of optical globules are undetected; some lie at less sensitive mosaic edges.

evidence.quote: About 10% of the globules detected at optical wavelengths are undetected here up to the sensitivity threshold of the ALMA observations.
Of these, Th19, Th21, and Th42 lie close to the less sensitive edges of the mosaic

limitations_admitted.value: Th01B and Th01C cannot be separated spatially in continuum.

evidence.quote: Th01B-Th01C (which cannot be spatially separated in the continuum image, because they overlap in projection along the line of sight)

limitations_admitted.value: Star–globule separation is uncertain; the 13 pc case gives larger acceleration times and initial distances.

evidence.loc: Distance between the globules and the ionizing stars
evidence.quote: However, the separation between the globules and the O stars is not clear.
these numbers would be scaled accordingly implying larger $t_{\rm start}$, and $R_{\rm start}$ values

limitations_admitted.value: Fragmentation and detachment can accelerate destruction and oppose protostar formation.

evidence.quote: The fragmentation process greatly speeds up photo-evaporation of the globules and opposes the collapse and formation of protostars within them.
Refinement of the toy model for photoevaporation presented here may include a more accurate approach for the shrinking of globules with time, fragmentation and detachment.

limitations_admitted.value: Additional globules lie outside the ALMA and HST fields; ionized-gas kinematics and higher-resolution protostellar searches remain needed.

evidence.quote: there are more globules in the southwest of IC 2944, located outside the ALMA and HST fields of view
Another experiment is to measure the kinematics of the ionized gas streaming off the globule through recombination line observations to test whether this may propel the globules.

probing the dust emission from millimeter to near-infrared wavelengths with higher angular resolution and searching for protostellar seeds can reveal possible star-formation content within the globules

referee_caveats_inferred: The abstract reports 12 new detections, while results and summary report 13; reconcile before using source counts as answer keys.
The printed observing-date range spans 2016–2025 despite the description of one session; verify the actual executions.
The 830 yr gradient timescale needs its derivation and distance convention before reuse.
The printed Jeans-mass expression and continuum-mass normalization need clarification before numerical reproduction.
The text's collapse discussion should be checked against the individual Jeans ratios in the continuum table.
Line-of-sight velocities are used as current rocket speeds without a stated deprojection.
An integration stopped at 50 pc does not establish the complete evaporation time; distinguish endpoint bounds from destruction times.
Th01A survival descriptions differ between discussion and summary; preserve their separate provenance.
No imaging flux-recovery assessment is given despite the stated maximum recoverable scale.
The toy model provides conditional histories rather than a unique demonstration of rocket acceleration.

The calibrated data underlying this article is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

missing_for_reproduction: Exact calibrated dataset or execution identifiers and the applied calibration material.

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Not quantifiable from the text; 19-pointing mosaic with several spectral windows, but total bandwidth, channel counts, and visibility sampling are missing.
reproducibility.score_reason: Project code, beams, sensitivities, physical assumptions, and integration timestep are supplied. Exact calibration, imaging, apertures, fitting, and model implementation are missing; several printed results need reconciliation.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main results are numeric and an archive project is identified, but the processing recipe is incomplete and calibrated data are offered upon request rather than explicitly as public products.
